Resolves #20048
Related: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#240, neomjs/neo-agent-skills#242

Adds the `Stage work (neomjs/neo-stage)` trigger line to `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` `§edge_case_triggers` so that sessions rooted in `neomjs/neo` read `../neo-stage/VISION.md`, `../neo-stage/ROADMAP.md`, and `../neo-stage/AGENTS.md` (which carries the Stage gates) before any Stage work and after every compaction, while compacting redundant prose in `AGENTS.md` from `24,270` B to `23,285` B (`-985` B net) to eliminate Antigravity's `354`-byte tail truncation (`<truncated 354 bytes>`).

Evidence: L3 (verified `AGENTS.md` byte size `23,285` B via `wc -c` and `npx --no-install neo-agent-skills-substrate-size`, leaving `631` B headroom below Antigravity's `23,916` B content ceiling and `1,291` B below the `24,576` B guard limit, plus live Antigravity `<RULE[.../neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md]>` reload receipt on this branch showing zero `<truncated ...>` footer) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

Micro-review eligible: docs-only — single-file `AGENTS.md` trigger line addition and prose compaction (`-985` B net).

## Slot Rationale & Turn-Memory Pre-Flight (`ADR 0007`)
- **Added trigger (`§edge_case_triggers` — `Stage work (neomjs/neo-stage)`):**
  - **Disposition:** `compress-to-trigger` (`+281` B).
  - **Placement check (`/turn-memory-pre-flight`):** All agent sessions start in `neomjs/neo`, so `../neo-stage/AGENTS.md` is never auto-loaded by any harness at boot or after compaction. A scope-conditioned trigger in `neomjs/neo/AGENTS.md` `§edge_case_triggers` is the minimum turn-loaded routing surface that cannot be skipped by a seat rooted in the Engine checkout.
  - **Trigger-frequency × failure-severity × enforceability:** Fires on every Stage lane pickup and post-compaction resume; prevents high-severity architectural derailment by routing seats to Stage's own `VISION.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, and `AGENTS.md`; enforced via intake/recovery direction read.
  - **Retirement trigger:** Retire this line when every seat's Stage session is rooted in the Stage checkout, measured by a boot receipt.
- **Compacted sections (`§verify_before_assert`, `§friction_to_gold`, `§contributions_over_commits`):**
  - **Disposition:** `rewrite` (`-1,266` B gross, **`-985` B net**: `24,270` B → `23,285` B), preserving `"PR-review is the last line of defense"` in `§verify_before_assert` (cited by `pr-review/SKILL.md:9`) and `"Within Neo workflow interpretation... including auto-mode preferences"` in `§contributions_over_commits`.
  - **Why:** `AGENTS.md` at `24,270` B exceeded Antigravity's actual `24,000` decimal-byte `<RULE[/path/to/AGENTS.md]>` limit (`23,916` content bytes + `84`-byte wrapper tag), silently truncating the last `354` bytes (`Wake/Heartbeat → run the cycle`). Compacting duplicate explanations restores full visibility of the tail of `§edge_case_triggers` with `631` B of real Antigravity headroom.
- **Decision Record impact:** aligned-with `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md`.
